subject.title: [OAuth] Client ID revoked `app_EMoamEEZ73f0CkXaXp7hrann` - fresh ChatGPT Plus logins completely broken

question: Should OpenClaw rotate or override the built-in OpenAI ChatGPT/Codex OAuth client ID, and if so should that follow upstream Codex or a maintainer-owned OpenClaw OAuth app?
rationale: The code change is small only after a valid OAuth app, allowed scopes, redirect behavior, and upstream Codex compatibility are confirmed; automation cannot register or validate that app ownership decision safely.

options.title: Verify and coordinate rotation
options.body: Use a real fresh ChatGPT Plus/Pro browser login to confirm the invalid-client failure, then rotate or align the client ID and scopes across all OpenAI OAuth paths with regression and live proof.

options.title: Defer to upstream Codex
options.body: Keep the current ID until upstream Codex publishes or confirms a new supported app/client contract, and document device-code or API-key fallback meanwhile.

options.title: Support an explicit override
options.body: Add a maintainer-approved override path only if OpenClaw cannot own the default app, with clear docs and no silent change to existing refresh/device-code behavior.

recommendation.title: Verify and coordinate rotation
recommendation.body: Use a real fresh ChatGPT Plus/Pro browser login to confirm the invalid-client failure, then rotate or align the client ID and scopes across all OpenAI OAuth paths with regression and live proof.
